items.title: E-commerce boosts Home Depot, Lowe’s in Q3
items.zh_title: 电商业务推动 Home Depot 与 Lowe's 三季度增长
items.zh_oneliner: 两家家居零售商的线上业务均实现两位数增长，持续投入改善线上购物体验。
items.en_oneliner: Home Depot and Lowe's both posted double-digit growth in their digital businesses in Q3 as they keep investing in the online experience.

items.title: Traffic recovery at T.J. Maxx, Marshalls boost TJX in Q3 as pressures mount
items.zh_title: 客流回升推动 TJX 三季度增长，但压力犹存
items.zh_oneliner: T.J. Maxx 与 Marshalls 客流回升带动 TJX 三季度业绩，不过增长仍显温和，还面临二手转售与同行竞争的压力。
items.en_oneliner: Recovering foot traffic at T.J. Maxx and Marshalls lifted TJX's Q3 results, though growth was modest and competition from resale and rival Ross is mounting.

items.title: Economic optimism plunges to lowest level since Great Recession
items.zh_title: 经济乐观情绪跌至大衰退以来最低水平
items.zh_oneliner: 盖洛普调查显示，美国消费者经济乐观情绪跌至大衰退以来最低，通胀担忧仍是主因。
items.en_oneliner: Gallup finds U.S. consumer economic optimism at its lowest since the Great Recession, with inflation still the main worry.

items.title: ACI Worldwide’s CEO heads out
items.zh_title: ACI Worldwide 首席执行官离任
items.zh_oneliner: 支付公司 ACI Worldwide 首席执行官离任，管理层出现变动。
items.en_oneliner: ACI Worldwide’s chief executive is departing, marking a leadership change at the payments company.
